result.title: PURE: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Multi-Granularity Multimodal Identity Matching
result.summary: Identity matching asks whether two records denote the same identity, yet the answer depends on the target granularity. Two records may match at the base level but not at the variant level: they share an underlying design while differing in attributes such as color or size. Final matching accuracy does not separately characterize the capabilities involved. To study this problem, we use e-commerce as a challenging real-world domain. We introduce PURE, a diagnostic benchmark for multi-granularity multimodal identity matching covering four capability dimensions: Perception, Understanding, Reasoning, and Evidence-grounded Judgment. The benchmark comprises 1,457 multiple-choice questions across 14 tasks, derived from real-world matching pairs and verified by two domain experts. Across ten recent MLLMs, overall scores range from 47.1% to 86.0%. Understanding receives the highest mean score and Judgment the lowest, with weaknesses in visual difference localization and variant-level rule judgment. Modality ablations show that models benefit from multimodal evidence but can incorrectly identify conflicts between matching records. In direct matching, most models recognize matching pairs more reliably than non-matching pairs at the base level, whereas the reverse holds at the variant level. PURE therefore reveals what aggregate matching accuracy hides: not only whether models judge a pair correctly, but where they struggle to interpret evidence and apply matching criteria.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 PURE，一个多粒度多模态身份匹配诊断基准，由真实电商匹配对构建 1457 道选择题、14 项任务，按感知、理解、推理与证据判断四个维度评测十个 MLLM，并报告基础级与变体级匹配的系统性差异。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「视觉差异定位」与「证据支撑的变体级规则判断」弱点分析及模态消融，可诊断 VLM 是否真正使用视觉证据，与研究关注的视觉细节保留和证据筛选相关，可供失败分析核查；但未涉及 latent 状态生成或训练监督。
